entries.zh: 觊觎他人之物；贪恋别人的东西
entries.en: to covet another's possessions (17c Sp. codiciar cosas ajenas)
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注〔疑:妬/婪〕，首字判读依赖推断；M lām 与 R lân 均合“婪”，语义取 codiciar ajenas。

entries.zh: 贪谋；起心贪图、谋划攫取
心想；心里想要、存心贪求
entries.en: to desire in one's heart; to covet, wish for

entries.zh: 贪冒；觊觎攫夺（西语 desear mal＝存心不良而贪求）
entries.en: to covet with ill intent; to greedily usurp (codiciar, desear mal)

entries.zh: 噬人；噬夺、吮吸他人财物（敲诈盘剥人）
entries.en: to devour/fleece people; to snatch and suck away what belongs to others

entries.zh: 满心是钱；一心只认得钱（贪财成性）
entries.en: having nothing but money in one's mind; avaricious, money-minded (codicioso, avaro)
entries.notes: 汉字“係是錢”句式与西语 avaro 对应较曲（係=只/满是），判读依赖推断。

entries.zh: 贪赃；官吏贪受贿赂（马尼拉语境指中国官员贪赃）
entries.en: to take bribes/graft (as a mandarin); corruption in office
entries.notes: R 栏〔疑:tan chāng/fon chang〕首字判读不定；贓 chāng 与 M chōng 互证，语义取贪赃。

entries.zh: 恋恋不舍年复一年；贪恋不已、贪得没完（西语谓贪之过甚）
entries.en: clinging covetously year after year; excessively greedy (codicioso demasiado)
entries.notes: 汉字“戀戀年”与西语 codicioso demasiado 的对应对表面贴切但实义关系依赖推断，且原意或指贪恋不舍。

entries.zh: 抢钱；见钱就抢、什么都想要
entries.en: to snatch at money; to grab whatever one wants (codicioso, todo lo quiere)

entries.zh: 重利；贪图厚利、放债取重息
entries.en: to take heavy interest; greedy for profit, usurious (codicioso mucho)

entries.zh: 尺；度量用的尺（西语 codo medir＝量尺寸）
entries.en: a ruler/foot measure; to measure (Sp. codo medir)

entries.zh: 用手后量脚；以手为度、以脚后为尺量长度
entries.en: to measure by hand-span and foot-length; to size up with hand and foot
entries.notes: 第二变体 chiú āu re 的“re”判读不明（或为第二方言写法）；语义取量度。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（西语 cod del Graco.，汉字与闽南音两栏为〔空〕）
entries.en: [manuscript blank; gloss uncertain] (Sp. cod del Graco. — perhaps 'elbow/codo of the Greek')
entries.notes: H/M 两栏〔空〕，R 栏 “lom day.” 无法对应可靠词义，仅能存疑。

entries.zh: 赂；贿赂、送礼行贿之物（西语 cohechos）
entries.en: bribes, gifts given to corrupt (Sp. cohechos)
entries.notes: R 栏〔疑:hi/lu〕两读并存，仅能依 M lõ 与汉字“賂”定语义。

entries.zh: 赃；官员受贿所得的赃物赃钱（马尼拉语境指 Mandarin 的赃私）
entries.en: graft, illicit gains of a mandarin; bribe money (cohecho del mandarin)

entries.zh: 后手；经手收纳（受贿）之人、幕后经手
entries.en: the go-between/hand behind (a bribe); backhanded receipt (cohecho)
entries.notes: “后手”在闽南语兼指幕后经手人，与 cohecho 的对应依赖推断。

entries.zh: 手捻内；把（贿物）攥在手心里——收受贿赂攥紧不放
entries.en: to clench in the hand what is within; to clutch/grasp (a bribe) tightly (cohecho, apretar la mano lo que tiene dentro)

entries.zh: 后手钱；给经手人的贿赂钱、打点钱
entries.en: money passed to the go-between; bribe money (cohechar, o cohechos de dineros)
